note: Metronome v2, UA cohort: synchronized re-download loop against the seven pre-existing UA listings' 0.7.3 reuploads, onset 2026-09-06 (the eu-maps 0.7.3 release day), ~6.8/day per listing in fixed slots regardless of listing popularity (zaporizhzhia/kryvyi-rih at 1.0-1.1/day organic run the same weekly totals as kharkiv/lviv/odesa at ~2/day; kyiv = the same uniform floor plus its own ~6/day organic, matching its v0.1.0-era rate). The v0.2.0 traffic is modeled as a loop-inflated ADOPTION release: legitimate traffic = organic update adoption of the 07-08 install base plus new organic demand, estimated from three clean yukina pack-refresh adoption curves (brno 0.4.1, asahikawa 0.2.2, bydgoszcz-torun 0.5.0 - max-fraction pooling errs toward attributing less). The retired 0.1.0 versions carry no incident-window traffic (assets retired at the reupload) and are not targeted; the spec is adoption-targets-only. Loop NOT yet extinguished (healthy live listings - no deprecation kill available); incident_end stays open and re-applies accrue until the client dies or is blocked. MANUAL CAP (2026-10-03, maintainer ruling): after application, per-day attributed fetches were capped at 7/listing (the measured uniform loop rate) for all seven adoption targets, re-crediting 434 fetches the peer-adoption allowance had over-attributed (kyiv +150; capital/peer ratio structure across CZ/SK/HU packs validates the uniform-loop model - kyiv:peers matches Praha:Brno at ~3x). Final attribution ~181-189/listing. IMPORTANT: after any attribution-ledger rebuild, re-apply this spec THEN re-apply the cap (scratchpad script cap-ua-attribution.js pattern: clamp this incident daily asset amounts to 7, window >= 2026-09-07). New accruing days naturally run at/below the cap.
